assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding established a fundamental mechanism by which cells achieve functional proteomes, with broad consequences for cell biology and disease.
assessment.attribution: The two credited investigators represent a focused and strongly attributable experimental discovery.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has been extensively reproduced, elaborated, and integrated into modern proteostasis biology.
uncertainties: The contribution is foundational molecular biology rather than a single clinical advance.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The nuclear hormone receptor framework transformed understanding of ligand-regulated transcription and connects physiology, development, metabolism, and pharmacology.
assessment.attribution: The listed credit is concise, although the broader receptor field involved numerous consequential contributors.
assessment.maturity: Its biological and therapeutic significance has been sustained over decades.
uncertainties: The breadth of the superfamily makes the boundary of a prize-defining contribution difficult to draw.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a central signaling system coupling endoplasmic-reticulum protein-folding status to cellular adaptation.
assessment.attribution: Mori and Walter are well matched to the core mechanistic discovery.
assessment.maturity: The pathway is deeply established across cell biology, physiology, and disease research.
uncertainties: The pathway's multiple branches and later contributors complicate a fully comprehensive attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA enabled a major shift to noninvasive prenatal screening, with direct and widespread medical impact.
assessment.attribution: The candidate formulation identifies a singular foundational contribution and a clear credited investigator.
assessment.maturity: The approach has been validated at scale and incorporated into clinical practice.
uncertainties: Clinical implementation raises important questions of access, counseling, and appropriate use that are distinct from the discovery itself.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing provided a compelling molecularly targeted therapy for a severe inherited disease and demonstrated the therapeutic reach of RNA biology.
assessment.attribution: The two proposed laureates capture complementary mechanistic and translational components.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy and durable real-world use provide substantial confirmation.
uncertainties: The translation involved extensive additional clinical and industrial work beyond the core discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and incretin-based therapeutics have changed treatment of diabetes and obesity while illuminating endocrine control of metabolism.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names span core physiological discovery and biological development, but the full history includes several major contributors.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic class has exceptional clinical confirmation and population-level importance.
uncertainties: Attribution among peptide discovery, receptor biology, and drug development is intrinsically complex.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Recognition of distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages supplied a defining conceptual foundation for modern adaptive immunology.
assessment.attribution: The two credited investigators correspond directly to the complementary lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The framework has been repeatedly confirmed and underpins immunological research and medicine.
uncertainties: Its age and extensive subsequent development can make the appropriate temporal framing of recognition less clear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genomic imprinting established parent-of-origin-specific gene expression as a fundamental exception to equivalent parental genomes, reshaping developmental genetics and epigenetics.
assessment.attribution: Surani and Solter are appropriately linked to foundational demonstrations, though the field developed through multiple intersecting observations.
assessment.maturity: The phenomenon and its mechanistic importance are firmly established.
uncertainties: The candidate framing covers both discovery and a broad mechanistic field with many additional contributors.
